description.en: SenseTime's SenseNova platform with an OpenAI-compatible gateway covering text chat, multimodal understanding, image generation, tool calling and streaming; the Token Plan is currently in a free open beta (credits-based) with DeepSeek V4 Flash, SenseNova Flash-Lite, GLM-5.2 and more.

detail.en: SenseNova is SenseTime's large-model platform. Its OpenAI-compatible gateway (https://token.sensenova.cn/v1, set as base_url in the OpenAI SDK) provides text chat, multimodal understanding, image generation, tool calling and streaming responses. Quick start: register an account and complete phone verification, create an sk- prefixed API key in the console (API Keys), then point base_url to https://token.sensenova.cn/v1 (cURL / Python both supported). The Token Plan gateway is currently in a free open beta with a credits system (general + Flash-Lite pools, see the free-ai entry); beta status, model list and quota can change — check the platform page before relying on it.
detail.zh-Hans: 商汤日日新 SenseNova 是商汤科技的大模型平台。其 OpenAI 兼容网关（https://token.sensenova.cn/v1，在 OpenAI SDK 中作为 base_url 使用）提供文本对话、多模态理解、图像生成、工具调用与流式响应等能力，公测开放 sensenova-6.7、DeepSeek-V4、GLM-5.2 等免费模型。快速开始：注册账号并完成手机号验证，在控制台「API Keys」创建 sk- 开头的密钥，然后将 base_url 指向 https://token.sensenova.cn/v1 即可调用（支持 cURL / Python）。Token Plan 网关当前免费公测中，采用积分制（通用积分与 Flash-Lite 专属积分，详见 free-ai 对应条目）；公测状态、模型名单与额度可能调整，请以平台页面为准。
